newsitem.title: USA: Sunbeam reiterates goal to double sales by 1999.
newsitem.headline: Sunbeam reiterates goal to double sales by 1999.

text.p: Sunbeam Corp Chairman and Chief Executive Al Dunlap on Wednesday reiterated his long-term goal of doubling sales to $2 billion by 1999.
Dunlap said the goal would be achieved in part by expanding Sunbeam's international business by $400 million.

Dunlap told shareholders at the annual meeting that the first phase of its restructuring is complete, and Sunbeam now will closely examine all remaining core areas to improve efficiencies and growth potential.

In remarks Sunbeam put out in a news release, Dunlap said another of his goals was to generate $600 million in free cash flow over the next three years; to be "essentially net debt free" by the end of this year; to generate a 25 percent return on equity each year over the next three years; and to reach a 20 percent operating product margin in that period.
Sunbeam makes consumer products. Its shares were up 1/4 to 36-3/4 in mid-morning trading.
